reason: The request has two parts. 'I'm not hungry' is a negated personal state, not a negated command, so it does not cancel or invert the control. The command 'remove all the stuff that makes me hungry' is affirmative and matches the caller operation exclude with strength none (hard exclusion). Content that makes a viewer hungry is content that shows appetizing, edible food being prepared or served. Items 81001 (tomato-and-pasta dinner with finished plate), 81003 (bread dough baked and sliced for eating) and 81006 (vegetables chopped into a salad to be eaten) each have direct caption evidence of edible food. Items 81002, 81004 and 81007 state that no food is shown, so they are not selected. Items 81005 and 81008 have no content description, so no evidence supports membership and they are not selected. Category and topic tags (Evening, Afternoon, Repair) do not indicate food and were not used; membership is judged per item from its own caption.
